records.title: A consultant for community based climate resilience through integrated climate change adaptation disaster risk reduction early warning & systems
records.summary: REQUEST FOR CONSULTANTS The Adventist Development and Relief Agency (ADRA) is a global humanitarian organization with a mission to work with people in poverty and distress to create just and positive changes. ADRA Somalia belongs to the worldwide network, comprised of more than 130 supporting and implementing country offices. ADRA Somalia is seeking to recruit a consultant for strengthening community-based climate resilience through integrated climate change, adaptation disaster risk reduction, early warning and systems and anticipatory action. Somalia continues to face multiple and interconnected challenges, including protracted conflict, recurrent droughts and floods, displacement, environmental degradation, poverty, and increasing pressure on livelihoods and essential services. These challenges have heightened the vulnerability of communities to climate-related and other disasters, particularly among women, children, older persons, persons with disabilities, internally displaced populations, and other marginalized groups. records.title: National Consultant (Climate Mobility Research and Data)
records.summary: Overview of position Nature of the consultancy: Deliverable Based Consultancy (output-based) Research, data, consultation and in-person facilitation support to the International Consultant for the gender-sensitive Climate Mobility Needs Assessment and Country Diagnostic for Somalia and for the co-creation and validation of the Climate Mobility Programme for integration into the NDC 3.0 Investment and Implementation Plan, where feasible. Project Context and Scope: Background Recurrent droughts, floods and environmental degradation, combined with fragility and conflict, drive large-scale human mobility and displacement in Somalia. The National Adaptation Plan (NAP 2.0, 2026–2030) and the Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0) both recognise human mobility in the context of climate change as a priority. However, limited consolidated data and institutional capacity make it difficult to turn these commitments into investment-ready interventions, and human mobility is not yet well reflected in the NDC 3.0 Investment Plan 2025–2030 launched by the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (MoECC) at COP 30. records.summary: ReDSS is a secretariat working on behalf of 14 international and national NGOs responding to forced displacement in East Africa, the Horn of Africa and the Great Lakes region. ReDSS was established in 2015 in response to a desire by the NGO community to be more proactive in shaping durable solutions policy and programming in the region. Our team works both at regional and country level and focusses on the translation of evidence and research into policies and programmes that can better deliver for displacement-affected communities. This is achieved through a range of activities, including convening key stakeholders at multiple levels to build consensus around collective actions; supporting new evidence generation through commissioning and undertaking research and analysis; and building the capacity of key actors through delivering training and developing tools and guidance among others.
